title: Platinum Rewards Card: What to Do If You Suspect Fraudulent Activity
summary: This document explains what to do if you suspect fraudulent activity on a Platinum Rewards Card: lock the card in the app, review recent transactions, and report suspected fraud via the app or support channels (enhanced protection: Yes). It states fraud alerts are targeted for response within 17 minutes, and if unauthorized activity is confirmed, your card number will be replaced and disputes assisted; it also lists what details to prepare (date, amount, merchant, card-in-possession status, and any relevant travel or unusual patterns) plus aftercare steps (monitor alerts, update merchants/subscriptions, re-enable only when secure).
